S9 E9 — Sea Turtle SubmarineBlaze and AJ are at the beach when they meet an adorable new friend: Shelly the sea turtle! But when Shelly can't find her way home to the Seaweed Forest, Blaze turns into a Sea Turtle Submarine to help lead the way!
S9 E10 — The Clean MachineWhen three of Blaze's friends end up in messy trouble, Blaze must save them by turning into the soapiest, sudsiest cleaning machine of all time: Clean Machine Blaze!

S6 E22 — Pups Save A Humsquatch / Pups Save A Flying Disc FlingTravelling Travis yelps for help when he finds a mysterious creature in trouble. The PAW Patrol heads to Foggy Bottom to save a Humsquatch!
S6 E23 — Pups Rescue A Rescuer / Pups Save The Phantom Of The Frog PondMayor Goodway tries to help the PAW Patrol rescue Danny, but the pups end up having to rescue the rescuer, too!
S1 E12 — Under The Fairy Moon Pt. 1While gathering starburst flowers for the Fairy Moon ball, an accident breaks Isabel's trust in River, allowing a mysterious stranger to step in.

S3 E13 — The Crew Builds A Mega Stunt Ramp / The Crew Builds A Giant Solar FarmRubble & Crew use their giant trucks to make awesome stunt ramps when Mega Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition. Power problems shut down Sierra Sparkle's show.

S6 E7 — Robo Puppy!When a bossy cyborg named the Glitch hacks all the robots in Robotopolis and forces them to dance The Robot, it's up to Robot Mechanic Molly and Robo Puppy to stop him before it's too late!
S6 E8 — The Kingdom Of Sleepwell!All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleep well: Princess Deema can't fall asleep! Her Royal Court comes to her aid, but magic doesn't work.

S2 E7 — The Meow-Mazing GamesWhen Gabby, Pandy, and Carlita prepare for the annual Meow-Mazing Games, they encounter stiff competition from the Doodads and must work together to bring home the coveted dollhouse trophy.

S3 E7 — Veggie Burgers & Secret Sauce / RatatouilleChef runs out of secret sauce and must brave the Stump's secret recipe vault. / Chef needs soft soil for planting but struggles to befriend the helpful garden worms.
S4 E12 — My Tooth Fell OutDuring breakfast, Sofi loses a baby tooth. She will receive a visit from the tooth fairy.

S2 E20 — Pickle PowerCrusher builds a vacuum to clean up his big mess, but the machine goes haywire, sucking up Crusher & everything in its path! Now Pickle must team up with Blaze & AJ to stop the vacuum & save Crusher.

S2 E16 — Race Car SuperstarBlaze & AJ visit VelocityVille, a town full of race cars where everybody loves to go fast! When a snooty car named Speedrick traps all the other racers, Blaze must transform free his new friends.

S3 E20 — Pups Get Skunked / Pups And A Whale Of A TaleWhen Everest gets sprayed by a skunk, the pups delicately try to tell her she needs a bath! The pups put fly far north to help free a baby whale that's trapped under an ice sheet.

S3 E21 — Parroting Pups / Merpups Save The TurbotsRocky loses his voice and has trouble using his pup pack, but Matea the parrot has no problem doing it for him. A sea slug gets in the way of Cap'n Turbot's plan to take photos of magical merpups.

We leave the hustle and bustle behind, to explore stunning homes set in some of Australia's most picturesque country locations.
We explore family retreats that offer the perfect balance of style and room to create memories together.

This week with the Gurus, Trevor has some great watering tips, Nigel gets his hands dirty with a DIY project, Shy keeps your memory sharp and Bonnie shows you how to get started on lighting your garden.

Week three on The Blocktagon begins and there are big plans for some impressive master bedrooms and walk-in robes. From day one Andrew and Whitney struggle with the building schedule and foreman Keith and Dan are forced to intervene.

A Canadian couple relocates to Tangiers, Morocco, excited to embrace the culture; he favours a traditional Moroccan-style space in keeping with their move, but she prefers a modern, spacious kitchen that similar to the comforts of home.

A couple bumps up against their inability to compromise in their search for a larger family home in Phoenix. She's looking for something nice with a pool, but there's fierce competition in the area, and he wants to avoid the expense.

A single mom and her son look to relocate from California back home to Boca Raton, Florida. She wants a single-family home on the beach, but since her mom is helping with the down payment, she has her own opinion on the best place.

Brett restores a 1930s two-story Spanish Colonial farmhouse in Fontana, Calif.; he learns the rich history of the home which then guides his design plan for the house exterior, entryway, living room, and kitchen.

A couple recently bought his grandparents' Fox Chapel home, but some awkward additions through the decades have left it with a funky floor plan. Leanne and Steve Ford knock down walls to turn a closed off house into a bougie, Bohemian family home.

Pacific NW real estate. Twin sisters help people sell homes. The sisters put their own money into the renovation. When the home sells, they take their investment off the top of the profits then split the rest with the home owners.
A couple looking to downsize buys a home along the Connecticut coastline; they'll have to put in the work, though, to renovate the fixer-upper that's located in their dream neighbourhood of Lordship.

Tonight there's major construction work to the exterior of the building. The old fire stairs are being relocated and the northern side of the building will be flooded in natural light. The less experienced renovators are struggling with the work load.

It's Irene's Birthday and she has received a gift parcel from her father. It includes a piece of music he has written for her specially.
It's the day Sol becomes a man, but he's playing Zaag with his rabbi instead of writing the speech for his bar mitzvah.

Trixie sets out to find the unruly little neo-protoform slugs who have wandered off into the woods. Meanwhile, Eli has been ceaselessly training with Burpy, wondering if his best friend will ever battle with him again.
After escaping Adura, Team Chosen is trapped in The Deep. In Elu, Kanfo and the Elu Mesi debate resources for a POTD invasion, while Omolola acts.
When Snorp goes missing in an alternate dimension, Que heads up the search party, only to discover that underappreciated Snorp has actually left home for good.
A ghostly inmate haunts an inescapable prison.
While Hedgehog braves her first witch coven sleepover, Oscar awaits a secret signal in case she needs to be rescued.
When an unknown figure shows up and insults their Mom, the kids are expecting a massive showdown but are surprised when Mom chooses the path of peace.
Richard's newspapers aren't selling, so his friends pull out all the stops to put the printed word back on top.

p.t: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
p.d: Max's mom is leaving for a space mission soon. When Marinette hears the news, she comes up with an idea to help Max cope well with the separation.
The Ninja find themselves scattered across the Merged Lands and encounter new threats in their search for a way home.
A mysterious force causes the Rising Volt Tacklers to begin dancing mindlessly.

Nate shows Gem his wild Minecraft base, they take on a pixel art challenge, and join forces on a secret cliff-side base! Will there be enough room for 100 frogs as well? Let's just say, it's a BLOCK-buster!
The big squares set out to land a square on the moon using square power alone. Learn about big square numbers with the Numberblocks.
Go and Stop are given some magic beans and discover that they can make amazingly shaped plants. But which ones look the best?
Snobby King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit the Little Kingdom, and Holly and her Mummy and Daddy enlist the Elf Band to impress them.
The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades.
When George Sr. accidentally lands the school librarian, Ms. Hutchins, in the hospital the Cooper family must nurse her back to health. Also, Meemaw gives Georgie relationship advice.
Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.
When Sheldon learns the house next door is for sale, he takes it upon himself to find the perfect neighbours; Missy is torn when she's forced to pitch against her boyfriend at the baseball game.
An abscessed tooth turns nasty for an aging sheep, Lulu the giraffe has her baby, and a dangerously skinny skink confounds the vet staff!
First impressions are everything in business, so Valerie Bertinelli and Duff Goldman give the kid bakers free rein to show off their bestselling dessert using the psychology of colour.
The junior chefs get fired up for a grilling competition with judges Amanda Freitag, NFL Hall of Famer Jerome Bettis and Cooking Channel's Ali Khan.

Queen Morgana begins a reign of terrible evil over the innocent citizens of Camelot. With Morgause's immortal army at her command, it seems there is no hope for Uther, who must watch his Kingdom crumble under his daughter.

When Eddie comes home with lice and infects others in the family, Louis leaves it to Jessica to clean up the mess. Meanwhile, Eddie's classmates suffer the consequences when he welches on a bet he made with his teacher.
Sheldon visits CalTech for the very first time. Also, Georgie is furious when Mary listens in on a phone call with his girlfriend. And Meemaw tries to cheer up a jealous Missy.
As our heroes tour the massive Devon Corporation, a mysterious intruder tries to steal an important piece of equipment!

There's a lizard in the lab! And it shares an amazing piece of body kit with you. Catch up with our Ouch Babies as each family goes for an ultrasound scan, and meet today's body popping Brilliant Body.
The Bears accidentally clone Ice Bear and Ice Bear has a hard time adjusting.
The Bears help a teenager become a famous singer.
Jeremy and Deena need to sneak into the playroom and shut down Glitch's Noise Maker machine before it wakes cousin Milo from his afternoon nap.
Spidey is in charge of delivering the cake to Hulk's birthday bash!
Vida helps Koa get over his fear of needles when he needs a porcupine quill removed.
Duggee has his Opposites Badge, and helps the squirrels understand that an opposite is something that is exactly different to another thing, by using lots of fun examples.
Miss Rabbit's train has broken down with a carriage full of passengers who need to get to work. Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train Gertrude.
With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

During a snowstorm, Ginger and the Pea-Rexes seek shelter in a cave. However, the once roomy cave is soon packed to the rafters. In the spirit of the season, the gang must find a way to keep everyone happy amidst the chaos.
The cadets are planning an epic surprise pool party for Phillipa's birthday but when things get out of hand, they forget the golden pool rule: keep the gate shut.
Fizzy and Suds explore pottery, murals, and First Nations art, discovering creativity, culture, and discover that everyone can be an artist.
When Grandfather Wellspring helps at the Rescue Fair, he teaches the trainees that creatures of all ages have something to offer.
Andy travels back in time 220 million years, to the time of cynodont - a dog-like furry creature with excellent eyesight and a powerful sense of smell.

p.t: Play School: Big Ted's Time Machine
p.d: Step back in time to the swinging 60s with Justine and Alex where they meet Play School icon, Monica! Big Ted plays hide and seek, and hopscotch with the other toys. They have fondue for lunch and watch the moon landing!
When a class tour of the airport goes wrong, it's up to Norman to use his gaming skills to control FireSwift until the Rescue Team arrives!
Zip is determined to get to the tippy top of the Wonder Tree! But when the rain makes the final climb too slippery, will he persevere?

Travel to the Cook Islands as Chris helps out at a vet clinic where ill and injured pets abound. Princess needs help following a hit and run, and Mani the duck has lost a fight. A goat and a wolfhound round out the medical menagerie.

Three-month-old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check-up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery, or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the open-heart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?
Two boxer puppies are found by police wandering the streets. After treating the dogs, he must find the owners. The trouble is Chris is bonding with the puppies and is going to find it hard to let go.

A miniature horse who is suffering from dwarfism disease was not meant to survive past six months. However his loving owner and a dedicated band of vets have beaten the odds and kept two-year-old Koda alive. Australia's smallest horse is also a regular visitor at the Royal Children's Hospital in Melbourne and lights up the lives of hundreds of sick kids. Now, however, the brave Koda faces another life threatening operation. Chris will be part of the elite surgical team that will decide Koda's fate.

Can Chris save 14-week-old bunny Alice as her two little owners look on? Meanwhile, a runaway dog decides to join the Bondi clinic staff, and a normally high-energy coolie comes into Sash with paralyzed back legs.

A beautiful kelpie is brought to Chris in a terrible state. A knock to the head as a puppy has caused severe balance problems but his condition is now deteriorating rapidly. His loving owner Heidi already has a baby to look after but she is constantly assisting Jasper and cannot bear the thought of losing him. In desperation, she looks to Chris for an answer. A brain scan shows his problems are inoperable but Chris refuses to give in.

Jen brings in her son's dog Jewel to Dr Chris to find out if she's expecting. The complication? This is an unplanned pregnancy and Jen suspects the father is her own dog, Token. X rays prove Jewel is having a football team of puppies. Get ready for a long night of anxiety, sadness and ultimately joy as Dr Chris helps Jewel through her ordeal. Funny scenes as proud father, Token keeps a close eye on proceedings to make sure his offspring are being well looked after.
A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner begs Chris to find a way to stop the execution.

Honey the spoodle leapt from a car doing 40 km/h to chase a cat. She survived, but how bad are her injuries? Owner Ilana's riddled with guilt for not strapping her in—and wait till you see Honey's reaction when she hears cats out the back.
Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour.

A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan's horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash, but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.
Chris is confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. A young girl's much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive tumour. But surgery on such a small patient is a challenge.

Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

TAPS investigates the historic Louisiana's Shreveport Auditorium where Elvis played his first concert. The paranormal activity is said to have started following the installation of a statue of The King. The spirits include a woman in white who Tango and Steve spot in the auditorium. Several team members also hear a male voice coming from the balcony area. Also, Amy returns from maternity leave.

The TAPS team travels to Little Rock, AR to investigate a bungalow and the neighboring residence in which strange happenings are affecting the Jones family. What will the TAPS team find there? Will they be able to ease the fears of the Jones family?

TAPS investigates the Belvoir Winery in Liberty, MO. Previously the facilities have been used as an orphanage, old folks home, and nursing home. The client believes some of the 10,000 who have died there are harmless ghosts of children, but other are more malevolent. During the investigation, Adam is touched, Jason and Steve hear a glass shatter, and Britt and Michelle chase a shadow figure.

Jason and the rest of The Atlantic Paranormal Society team travels to Boulder City, Nev., to investigate the claims of paranormal activity at Boulder City Hospital, which was built at the same time as the Hoover Dam and opened on November 15, 1931.

The Elms resort and spa of Excelsior Springs, Missouri, has been open for over a century. During that time it also served as a speakeasy frequented by gangsters. TAPS investigates claims of odd indentations on freshly-made beds, a man in white, strange shadows and swinging chandeliers. Their evidence includes odd sounds and a camera trying to focus on something unseen.

The owners of Allen Mansion in Monticello, Arkansas, call TAPS to investigate. They've seen furniture move on its own, black masses, and doppelgangers. It's believed the activity stems from the suicide of Ladell Allen, who's love affair with a married man broker her heart. TAPS members see black figures, smell sulfur, and record an EVP voice.

TAPS investigates two locations in Shreveport, Louisiana. The downstairs of the Rendall Building is a restaurant with the upstairs used as offices; it was once the morgue for those executed across the street at the courthouse. Reports include several figures, plus voices and old-fashioned music. At the courthouse, Adam and Amy experience hair pulling and a cell door shaking, but inside the restaurant, the team does much debunking.
TAPS travels to Scott Township, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennsylvania Asylum and Testing Lab.

TAPS visits the famously haunted Hyde Hall in Cooperstown, NY. The house was built in the 1800s by George Clark; upon his death, his children tossed their mother out. She's said to have put a curse upon all women who will ever live in the house. Amy and Adam have a mass move past them in a hallway; Jason and Steve experience an odd light in the baby's room. Also, something blocks one of their infrared cameras.

TAPS investigates the Soldier's Museum and the Jenny Wade House in Gettysburg, PA. The museum was once a orphanage operated by an evil woman, Rosa Carmichael, who horrifically mistreated the children. Many have reported seeing and hearing ghost children at that location. At the Wade house, two teams report seeing a black mass and their FLIR camera registers a human form walking the grounds.
TAPS travels to Buffalo, New York to investigate paranormal activity occurring on three former service vessels moored at the Buffalo Naval and Military Park.

On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Franklin, Kentucky to investigate Octagon Hallwhere secret tunnels have been found under the house, which are believed to have hidden confederate soldiersduring the civil war.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to Lucas, Ohio, to investigate claims of paranormal activity surrounding The Ceely Rose Murders; TAPS investigates the Bromfield Estate where questions about famous author and a family secret arise.

The Atlantic Paranormal Society travels to King George, Va., to investigate Belle Grove Plantation, which has ties to two U.S. presidents; next, the team travels to Winchester, Va., to investigate Historic Jordan Springs.

It's hard to know what's haunting the Cumberland Library and Monastery in Rhode Island. It could be nine settlers who were skinned alive and buried there in the 1600s. Or it could be the inhabitants of a monastery used for generations. Currently a library, people report voices, doors opening and slamming, and shadowy, floating monks around the property. Adam and Amy encounter something that turns the faucets on and off in a bathroom.

Pastor Joseph Prince preaches dynamic messages centred on the pure gospel of the grace of God. His desire is to help believers understand grace and how greatly blessed, highly favoured and deeply loved they are by their heavenly Father.

Connect follows a plucky school theatre group that aspires to stage every book of the Bible. The kids are pretty sure they have a clear understanding of everything that happens in 'God's Big Story'. Well…most of it.

Hear inspiration for change, healing, peace and joy through his affective communication connecting you to God, the church, and the world!
This week, our panellists discuss the issue of domestic violence, completing our journey through the Helping Hands Domestic Violence Study Guide.

A panel of women get together to share their lives, struggles, families, And the joy that occurs throughout their daily lives, And they also want to dig deeper to build a sense of community where they can work on relationships And their faith.

Every year, baby Jesus and Santa dominate all Christmas imagery. But who is this jolly fur-clad mythological figure? In this episode we discover his fascinating 1700 year evolution from a bishop of ancient Turkey to Santa Clause of the North Pole.

The TV4DADS team head to Florida. In Season 6 of the program, Brian teams up with his daughter Jeni (from Jeni:Seeking the Extraordinary) for an adventure in Florida that sees them catching fish, throwing axes, and being ambushed by killer birds.

There is more to you than meets the eye. You are a spirit being. You have a soul. You live in a physical body In this encouraging message, Pastor Bayless walks through three remarkable stories from Mark chapter 5 that reveal how Jesus brings freedom to the whole person. You’ll see how Christ delivers an oppressed soul, heals a broken body, and even restores life where all hope seemed lost. These stories remind us that no situation is beyond the reach of God’s power. Discover how coming to the feet of Jesus can change everything as you listen today.

Katherine Ruonala shares a practical message of love and hope to the nations. Reaching across denominational walls, her ministry is used to spread the fires of revival and ignite a fresh passion in the hearts of believers to go deeper in their relationship with God. Katherine carries a strong prophetic and miracle anointing with many experiencing instant healing in her meetings.

PowerPoint Ministries started as a vision of Dr Jack Graham and his wife, Deb, over 20 years ago. They believed that the power of God was evident in their growing church and that His Gospel message should be spread beyond the walls of that church to the world at large. They put their faith into action and purchased airtime on the Trinity Broadcasting Network. PowerPoint Ministries was then officially launched in April 1994. Over the past 19 years, PowerPoint Ministries has grown to an expansive network of local, national, and international television and radio broadcasts. In fact, PowerPoint can be seen or heard by a potential audience of millions of television viewers and radio listeners across the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, South Africa, Iran, Russia, Israel and more. The Ministry has a vision to glorify God by introducing Jesus Christ as Lord to as many people as possible and to develop them in Christian living using the most effective means to impact the world
Ever wonder why love can be painful? Today, Joyce reveals how dying to self brings freedom, healing, and growth, leading to a changed life through love.

The In Touch program reaches the world with the Gospel with messages that tackle such issues as parenting, finances, personal crises, emotions, and relationships. Dr. Stanley fervently believes the Bible to be the inerrant Word of God, a belief strongly reflected in his teaching. Dr Charles Stanley is the author of more than 50 books.

The chefs are tasked with recreating five dishes by Chef Ramsay, but one team member has to leave every couple of minutes until it's one chef standing. Later, instead of a dinner service, the chefs compete in a cook for your life challenge - determining who is sent home.
Ramsay introduces his daughter Tilly and challenges the chefs to cook for her sweet 16. One team struggles at service, while Bret fights to stay despite severe chest pain.

After losing the latest dinner service, tension builds in the Blue team while the Red team grows closer. For their next challenge, Chef Ramsay pits the teams against each other preparing authentic Chinese dishes, judged by Shirley Chung.

The MythBusters team up with all-star pitcher Matt Cain to tackle a batch of mini myths. Can you ride a bike underwater? Can a Shaolin Monk pierce glass with a needle? Does the potty dance actually help?
The team tackles crazy food myths—do exotic reptiles all taste like chicken? With chef Alton Brown, they cook lasagne in a dishwasher and an entire Thanksgiving dinner on a car engine.

On this episode of MythBusters, Adam and Jamie test the movie myth that a convict sandwiched between two chubby cops survived after their car was T'boned by a truck, while Kari Tory and Grant, take their foot off the gas as they find out if 'hypermiling' could double your mileage, and double your savings at the gas pump.
To test a trio of Hollywood car chase clichés Adam and Jamie are ‘the fast and the curious’ while Kari, Grant and Tory are on critter control.

On this special Indianapolis episode, the Mythbusters cut to the heart of some classic racing myths: can a man outrun a racecar over thirty feet? Do you really lose 10 pounds in weight from a three-hour race? And could a low-slung racecar produce enough suction to rip a cast-iron manhole cover from its moorings?

Things are about to get unstable, volatile and dangerous... because it's the MythBusters Breaking Bad Special. Joined by creator Vince Gilligan, and start Aaron Paul, the MythBsuters are scrutinizing the science and checking the chemistry of the hit TV show 'Breaking Bad'.

It's Round 2 of Battle of the Sexes and the MythBusters test the cliches: Will lost men really not stop and ask for directions? Are women better multi-taskers? Which sex can parallel park with aplomb? And should throwing like a girl really be an insult?

Myths tested: Will a crab pot drag you overboard to the bottom if your foot is caught in a coil? Is it better to work a 30-hour grind with no sleep than a 20 minute nap every 6 hours? Are crab pots truly indestructible?

On this 200th Episode of MythBusters the team are back with a vengeance returning to the myth that began the busting, JATO rocket car, but will it be third time lucky for this jet-assisted jalopy or will it go down in flames?
The team tackles four congestion questions that hold the key to unlocking gridlock!
Myths tested: Is a bathroom's hand dryer better than a paper towel? Which public restroom stall is the cleanest? Is better to stand in the doorway during an earthquake?

After seven years, Jamie and Adam decide to put some unsolved myths to the test, including a unique sphere that is supposed to paint a room with an explosion; the team takes on the fan request of splitting a boat in half with a channel marker.

Adam and Jamie test two myths about the power of the zombie hoard. First, can they really break through a door thanks to working as a team of pushing power? Second, what's the perfect weapon to use against the zombie hoard: gun or ax? Then Kari, Grant and Tory unleash their inner beast too as they find out if it's really inevitable that zombies will catch you even though they only shuffle at 2 miles an hour!
The guys test whether it's true that duct tape can be used in place of a seatbelt. Then, the guys are going to attempt to build a trebuchet with nothing but the talented tape and some 2 x 4s.
It’s wall-to-wall automotive mayhem, as the team drive through glass, plough through traffic, and fire an RPG at an SUV to take aim at classic Hollywood crash clichés.
Get inspired by the unique healing journeys of abused and exploited elephants.
In this episode, we follow life in one of Africa's elephant orphanages. Thanks to the dedication and passion of a team of the keepers, orphan elephants here are learning to adapt to life in the wild.
Camp Phoenix in Zambia's Kafue National Park is elephant heaven. It has thick forest, open grassland and plenty of water. Here a herd of orphan elephants are being given another chance.
Observe the fragile and evolving friendship between humans and elephants.
South Africa's Kruger National Park is one of the continent's largest game reserves, and the abundance of wildlife is perfect for big cats.
Savannah life isn't easy, even for the mighty 'Big Five' - the lion, African elephant, leopard, buffalo, and rhino. See how their adaptations help them in daily life.
There are more species of beetle worldwide than any other animal, and few play a role as important in the ecosystem as the humble dung beetle.

The Lake Erie Watersnake is currently on the brink of extinction, and researchers have been fighting to get it back. But when a lake is so toxic that not even the hardiest of invasive species can thrive, what should be done?
From rattlesnakes to cormorants, see how creatures with a bad rap get help.
Follow the winding path across the stunning Drakensberg mountains, one of Africa's great landscapes and home to countless animals.
Voyage high into the mountain sky and discover the Cloud Mountains of South Africa, a hidden world that serves as a window to an ancient time.
The wildlife of South Africa's coastline face a gruelling challenge as they navigate the area's severe, yet beautiful, landscape.
A day in the life of a southern African mangrove forest. We follow the forest and its residents through the change from high tide to low and back to high.
Life in this swamp is prolific and water dictates the rhythm of new life. It is home to a wide variety of African wildlife.
The African Penguin is the only penguin species that breeds in Africa, and it is found nowhere else.

SG-1 travels to Tollana to negotiate a trade. Col. Jack O'Neill becomes extremely annoyed when the Tollans refuse to cooperate, due to their fear that any weaponry given to Earth would more likely be used on itself than to protect against the Goa'uld.

SG-1 journeys to a planet where their arrival ignites a war between two cultures. A spy realizes his side could win the war if SG-1 and the Stargate can be neutralized. Will O'Neill and his team make the same realization and save themselves in time?

Bra'tac accompanied by his battered Jaffa apprentice arrives at Stargate Command pleading for medical assistance. He announces that Chulak the home planet to himself and Teal'c has been brutally attacked by Apophis and he goes on to explain that it was as though Apophis was looking for something. Dr. Daniel Jackson deduces that the something had to be Harsesis the child Apophis fathered with Sha're/Amaunet. This forbidden child would contain all the knowledge of the Goa'uld and if he were to fall into the wrong hands could be the Goa'uld's undoing.
An alien artifact causes Daniel to disappear, and the team looks for help from his institutionalized grandfather.
While preparing for a week of leave, Col. Jack O'Neill is engulfed in a white glow and disappears. Maj. Samantha Carter immediately recognizes that O'Neill has been transported away by the Asgard.

SG-1 is called upon to help a race of gentle, highly-intelligent aliens struggling against a swarm of deadly mechanical spiders called Replicators. But the situation becomes much more complicated when a lone Replicator is discovered back on Earth.

Stargate Command is contacted by Alar, a representative of the planet Euronda. His people are under attack and in need of help. Gen. Hammond sends SG-1 on a humanitarian mission to deliver food and medical supplies.

Anise, a new Tok'ra representative to Earth, approaches Stargate Command for help in testing some mysterious armband devices discovered amid the ruins of a distant planet. Anise believes the devices could be a powerful weapon in their war against the Goa'uld.Because symbiotes seem to render the devices ineffective, she requires human test subjects to prove her theory.
An incoming traveller, identified as a Jaffa priestess with whom Teal'C once had a relationship, claims to know how to destroy the Goa'uld.

A meeting of the Tok'ra High Council goes haywire when an SGC soldier flips out, attacking the council members before taking his own life, putting fear in the SGC as they realize that the Goa'uld now have a mind control weapon.
The SG-1 team meets Malikai, a human explorer from another world who shares Jackson's interest in an alien computer covered in a Latin-like script.

When the stargate won't open, trapping teams offworld, the SG-1 team investigates and learns that the Russians have their own stargate, apparently recovered from the sea after an Asgard ship crashed on Earth.The Russian stargate is locked open, maintaining a perpetual wormhole that defies explanation. At the request of Russian scientist Dr.

While conducting an archeological dig on planet P3X-888, Dr. Daniel Jackson makes a remarkable discovery: a primordial Goa'uld symbiote, an ancient, predatory version of SG-1's parasitical enemies.Before he can bring back his sample however, his team is attacked by an Unas. One team member is killed, and Daniel is dragged off into the wilderness by the giant primitive creature.

After O'Neill and the team help relocate displaced aliens to a new homeworld, another civilisation tries to colonise the same planet, leaving the team striving to discover a fair solution to the dilemma. Sci-fi drama, starring Richard Dean Anderson and Amanda Tapping.

The members of SG-1 find themselves working in an alien power station with new identities and no memory of their former selves; as the only person who recalls their true identities, it is up to Teal'c to attempt to set things right.

With less than 4 days left in the North Atlantic Bluefin Tuna season, the fleet race to claim the title of Gloucester's top earning bluefin boat. But with two top contenders, last season's champion Captain Dave Carraro of FV-Tuna.com and previous top-earner Captain Tyler McLaughlin on the Pinwheel, potentially sidelined, the field is wide open and it will all come down to the last fish.

It's opening day of the bluefin tuna season; after a mediocre performance in the Outer Banks, Capt. Dave Marciano is ready for his first season aboard his new boat, the Falcon; Capt. Tyler McLaughlin copes with the unexpected loss of his mate.
It's week two of the bluefin tuna fishing season and the sibling crew on the Pinwheel continue to fish in honour of their fallen mate.

When a familiar face returns to Gloucester to compete for the title of top bluefin fisherman, the fleet isn't very welcoming. And for one fisherman, the ocean just isn't big enough for the both of them.

The captains each have their own fishing ideologies, strategies and even superstitions, but they have to rely on a whole lot of luck to try to turn their fortunes around after a sudden bout of bad luck strikes the fleet.

Capts. Dave Marciano and TJ Ott struggle near the bottom of the leader board; Capt. Dave Marciano's nephew, Jay, brings a shot of energy to the Falcon; Capt. Tyler McLaughlin strives to pull ahead; all three captains turn to family members for help.

The captains are challenged when a large group of boats shows up for the weekend. Hot Tuna must decide whether to risk leaving a familiar bluefin hot spot in order to climb the leaderboard. Meanwhile, FV-Tuna.com’s and Pinwheel’s determination to be No. 1 in a tight race to the top forces the fleet to prove they can steer in the right direction to catch bluefin and stand out from the crowd.

Its almost the mid-point of blue fin tuna fishing season so the clock is ticking. Longtime rivals F/V-Tuna.Com and Pinwheel continue battling for the top spot in the fleet. But, a new strategy of boat alliances may threaten their dominance. Hot Tuna ] and Falcon work together and Paul Hebert gets his mojo back, but, trust is on the line for every boat along with big paydays and the elusive title of champion.

Stormy seas are on the horizon and when Mother Nature decides to flip her switch, the fleet must decide whether to stay and gamble or give up the hunt. Pinwheel and Dot Com have been fighting each other for the top spot on the leaderboard all season long, but with rough weather ahead, fish are biting and the title is up for grabs. Who wants it most?
As the season reaches a turning point, a change in the quota forces boats to push their limits, creating tension on the water.

The smaller quota of one bluefin tuna per day has changed the dynamic of the fleet, making it difficult to take or maintain a lead. It is imperative captains bring in a catch every single day. It also makes fishing far offshore a gamble because of the travel time and extra fuel costs. But one captain, desperate to salvage his season, decides to take his chances on a trip to Georges Bank.

Captain Tyler McLaughlin feels the pressure to stay ahead of his rival Captain Dave Carraro, but a new boat of friendly faces joins the fleet. The Whistler was formerly the original Pinwheel, and Captain Kevin Granfield is an old friend of McLaughlin’s. The two captains vow to help each other find fish and give McLaughlin the edge he needs to take the lead. Mechanical troubles plague the Falcon.
Captains weigh the decision of fishing 170 miles away from Gloucester where the fish promise to be big and profitable.
